Kept: files of every root but the saved tool outputs; in the repository only instruction, skill-definition, agent-config, mcp-config and hook-config files; never a skill's other files nor unclassified files of skill and plugin directories.

definitions.name: run_question_answers

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: The member who uploaded the session the run belongs to.

columns.name: session_id
columns.comment: Session of the run.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Stream of the run: empty for the main transcript, else the subagent.

columns.name: turn_idx
columns.comment: The run within its stream, as in runs.turn_idx.

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: Transcript revision (generation) of the session the answer was given for; run_answers shows an answer only while its session is committed at this revision.

columns.name: question_id
columns.comment: The run question, one wording; a reworded question has a new id.

columns.name: question
columns.comment: The wording the answer answered.

columns.name: probability
columns.comment: Probability (0 to 1) that the answer to the question is yes.

columns.name: provider
columns.comment: Who answered: the provider as configured (e.g. subq, jev, subq:run for whole runs); part of the key, so providers can answer the same question side by side.

columns.name: input
columns.comment: What the provider read: run (the run's whole text, secret-filtered) or note (the compact run note, sent when the run is larger than the provider takes or the provider reads notes).

columns.name: model
columns.comment: The model version that answered, as the provider reported it.

columns.name: cost_usd
columns.comment: What the answer cost: its share of the call that answered every question about the run.

columns.name: answered_at
columns.comment: UTC time the answer was stored.

definitions.comment: Run question answers: the probability of yes per question wording and run; written only by the API's run question worker.

columns.name: record_uuid
columns.comment: The line's own id as the agent wrote it (Claude Code uuid), the same on every record of the line; empty when the line has none (Codex) and on rows before parser 12, which is unknown, not missing.

columns.name: agent_version
columns.comment: Agent version that wrote the record: Claude Code version, Codex session_meta cli_version; empty when not recorded.

columns.name: entrypoint
columns.comment: How the agent was started: Claude Code entrypoint, Codex originator; empty when not recorded.

columns.name: denial_kind
columns.comment: Why a tool call did not run, as recorded (Claude Code toolDenialKind: permission-rule, user-rejected, cancelled, interrupted); empty otherwise.

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.comment: Recorded duration in milliseconds (tool result, Codex item or task, cost state); NULL when not recorded.

columns.name: timed_out_after_ms
columns.comment: Milliseconds after which the agent recorded a tool call as timed out; NULL when not recorded.

columns.name: interrupted
columns.comment: Whether the tool result records the call as interrupted; NULL when not recorded.

columns.name: git_operation
columns.comment: Git operations the agent recorded for a tool result (Claude Code gitOperation keys: push, pr, branch, commit); empty when not recorded.

columns.name: mcp_server
columns.comment: MCP server of a tool call as recorded (Claude Code attributionMcpServer, Codex McpToolCall server); empty otherwise.

columns.name: mcp_tool
columns.comment: MCP tool of a tool call as recorded (Claude Code attributionMcpTool, Codex McpToolCall tool); empty otherwise.

columns.name: attribution_skill
columns.comment: Skill the agent attributed the record to (Claude Code attributionSkill); empty when not recorded.

columns.name: facts
columns.comment: Further literal facts of the record, keyed by the L1 spec column name from the parser fact registry; a missing key means not recorded.

definitions.comment: Deterministic per-record transcript index for selective reads. Light columns answer structure questions; text is read only for explicit record drill-downs.

definitions.name: usage_events
definitions.comment: Versioned request-level usage facts and per-generation extraction receipts. Mutable timestamp/model fields are deliberately excluded from the replacing key.

columns.comment: Source node id, percent-encoded components joined by /: run user/source/session/agent/start record, session user/source/session/agent, commit repository/SHA, pull_request repository/number.

columns.comment: Relationship the evidence states: commit_created, commit_pushed, commit_captured, sha_mentioned, pr_named, pr_branch_head, pr_listed, ci_named, ci_on_branch_window, commit_in_pr, ci_on_sha, ci_for_pr.

columns.comment: Target node id: commit repository/SHA, pull_request repository/number, ci_run repository/kind/run id/attempt.

columns.name: evidence_id
columns.comment: Stable id of the evidence row that witnesses the relationship (observation, capture, snapshot or GitHub row).

columns.name: basis
columns.comment: Where the evidence came from: transcript, capture, hook or github.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Session owner for session evidence; empty for GitHub edges.

columns.name: source
columns.comment: Transcript source (claude_code or codex) for session evidence; empty for GitHub edges.

columns.name: session_id
columns.comment: Native session ID for session evidence; empty for GitHub edges.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Transcript stream for session evidence; empty for the main stream.

columns.name: turn_idx
columns.comment: Run number within the stream when the source is a run; zero otherwise.

columns.name: repository_id
columns.comment: GitHub repository ID the edge resolved in; reads keep only actively bound repositories.

columns.name: evidence_revision
columns.comment: Transcript revision of the evidence generation; zero for GitHub edges.

columns.name: evidence_parser_version
columns.comment: Git observation generation version of the evidence; zero for other bases.

columns.name: transcript_parser_version
columns.comment: Transcript records parser version of the evidence; zero for other bases.

columns.name: observed_at
columns.comment: UTC millisecond time of the evidence: observation, capture, snapshot or GitHub fact.

columns.name: matched_value
columns.comment: Literal value the evidence matched on: abbreviated SHA, branch, PR number, run id or membership head.

columns.name: match_rule
columns.comment: How the value matched: full_sha, unique_prefix, number, branch_head, run_id, branch_window, membership, merge_commit, head_sha, or the GitHub link basis.

columns.name: candidate_count
columns.comment: How many targets the value matched; an edge per target, so more than one is a branch or prefix shared by several.

columns.name: details
columns.comment: Small JSON object of further literal values (check label, branch window, ceiling reached, whether the PR head still contains the commit).

columns.name: resolver_version
columns.comment: Version of the worker rules that wrote the row.

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: Replacing version: monotonic build revision of the worker, so a later build wins.

columns.name: is_active
columns.comment: 1 while the relationship holds; 0 retracts it.

columns.name: written_at
columns.comment: UTC millisecond time the worker wrote the row.

definitions.comment: L1 edges between runs, sessions, commits, pull requests and CI runs, ordered by source; written only by the reconciliation worker.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Session owner.

columns.name: session_id
columns.comment: Native session ID within organization and user.

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: Raw transcript revision of the transcript records generation.

columns.name: parser_version
columns.comment: Transcript records parser version of the generation.

columns.name: index_version
columns.comment: Version of the run index rules; a new version is a new generation.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Transcript stream; empty for the main stream and the receipt.

columns.name: start_record
columns.comment: Raw record index of the record that starts the run (its prompt), as in the L1 edge run ids; 4294967295 for the receipt.

columns.name: row_kind
columns.comment: run, or receipt: one per build, written after its runs, holding session facts and committing the build.

columns.name: source
columns.comment: Transcript source: claude_code or codex.

columns.name: turn_idx
columns.comment: Run number within the stream; zero for the receipt.

columns.name: run_id
columns.comment: L1 run node id (user/source/session/agent/start record, percent-encoded), equal to l1_edges.from_id of the run.

columns.name: build_revision
columns.comment: Worker build revision that wrote the snapshot. In the key: each build is an immutable snapshot, and the newest receipt names the build readers read.

columns.name: built_at
columns.comment: UTC millisecond time the worker wrote the row.

columns.name: session_date
columns.comment: Session date of the generation.

columns.name: unrecorded_facts
columns.comment: Fact columns of this row whose values are unknown, not none: the parser version or agent cannot record them, or the usage extraction was incomplete.

columns.name: agent_version
columns.comment: First agent version recorded in the run (Claude Code version, Codex cli_version); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: entrypoint
columns.comment: First entrypoint recorded in the run (Claude Code entrypoint, Codex originator); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: Timestamp of the run's first record.

columns.name: ended_at
columns.comment: Timestamp of the run's last non-meta record; started_at when it has none.

columns.name: end_record
columns.comment: Start record of the next run in the stream, or one past the run's last record: usage on lines in [start_record, end_record) belongs to the run.

columns.name: minutes
columns.comment: Wall-clock minutes from the first record to the last non-meta record.

columns.name: active_minutes
columns.comment: Sum of the gaps between non-meta records, each capped at five minutes.

columns.name: record_count
columns.comment: Transcript lines of the run.

columns.name: raw_chars
columns.comment: Characters of the run's records before any cap.

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.comment: Sum of the duration_ms of the run's Codex task_complete and turn_aborted events; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it or no event records it.

columns.name: time_to_first_token_ms
columns.comment: time_to_first_token_ms of the run's first Codex task_complete; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it or no event records it.

columns.name: prompt_head
columns.comment: First 160 characters of the run's first genuine prompt; NULL when the run has none.

columns.name: genuine_prompts
columns.comment: Human prompts in the run (queued prompts included, delegated tasks not).

columns.name: prompt_subtype
columns.comment: The subtype of the prompt the run starts with, as the parser recorded it: '' for a prompt sent while the agent was waiting, queued (sent while it worked: the agent reads it at its next request, so the run before ends mid-work), delegation (a parent agent's task to a subagent); '' also when the run starts with no prompt. NULL when the parser version cannot tell them apart (Claude Code subagent streams before parser 11 read a coordinator's message as queued), and on runs built before the column existed.

columns.name: prompt_reactions
columns.comment: Word-list categories (negative, swear, apology, positive) the language-signals scanner finds in the run's first genuine prompt (its first 16,384 characters, as find scans it), sorted; empty when it finds none or the run has none. From run index 4; empty before.

columns.name: final_message
columns.comment: First 2,000 characters of the run's last assistant text when no tool call follows it in the run: what the agent said when it stopped. NULL when the run ended on a tool call, has no assistant text, or was built before run index 4.

columns.name: final_message_cut
columns.comment: Whether final_message holds only part of the message: it was longer than 2,000 characters, or the transcript stored it cut. From run index 4; false before.

columns.name: system_prompt_recorded
columns.comment: Whether the run's stream recorded the system prompt it received (a Claude Code prompt_snapshot attachment or Codex base instructions) at or before the run. From run index 4; false before.

columns.name: turn_origin
columns.comment: Claude turnOrigin of the run's starting prompt; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: prompt_source
columns.comment: Claude promptSource of the run's starting prompt; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: origin_kind
columns.comment: Claude origin.kind of the run's starting prompt; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: trigger_turn
columns.comment: First Codex inter-agent trigger_turn recorded in the run (true or false); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: thread_source
columns.comment: Codex session_meta thread_source of the run's stream (user, subagent, guardian_review); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: prompt_origin_basis
columns.comment: native when the starting prompt or its stream records a native origin field, else wrapper: the prompt kind comes only from the parser's wrapper rules.

columns.name: permission_mode
columns.comment: First Claude permissionMode recorded in the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: permission_modes
columns.comment: Every Claude permissionMode recorded in the run, sorted.

columns.name: auto_mode_bash_first
columns.comment: First Claude auto_mode bashFirst in the run (true or false); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: auto_mode_bash_first_steer
columns.comment: First Claude auto_mode bashFirstSteer in the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: auto_mode_bypass
columns.comment: First Claude auto_mode bypass in the run (true or false); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: auto_mode_steer_only
columns.comment: First Claude auto_mode steerOnly in the run (true or false); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: auto_mode_consent_flow
columns.comment: First Claude auto_mode autoModeConsentFlow in the run (true or false); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: approval_policy
columns.comment: First Codex turn_context approval_policy of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: approvals_reviewer
columns.comment: First Codex turn_context approvals_reviewer of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: sandbox_policy
columns.comment: First Codex turn_context sandbox_policy type of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: sandbox_network_access
columns.comment: First Codex turn_context sandbox network_access of the run (true or false); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: permission_profile
columns.comment: First Codex turn_context permission_profile type of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: collaboration_mode
columns.comment: First Codex collaboration mode of the run (turn_context or task_started); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: model
columns.comment: First model recorded in the run (Claude assistant message.model, Codex turn_context model); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: models
columns.comment: Every model recorded in the run's records, sorted.

columns.name: effort
columns.comment: First effort recorded in the run (Claude assistant effort, Codex turn_context effort); NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: efforts
columns.comment: Every effort recorded in the run (Claude assistant effort, Codex turn_context effort), sorted: more than one when the effort changed within the run, whose effort column holds only the first. Empty when none was recorded, and on runs built before the column existed.

columns.name: per_turn_effort
columns.comment: First Claude perTurnEffort recorded in the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: context_window
columns.comment: First Codex task_started model_context_window of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it or none was.

columns.name: context_input_tokens_at_start
columns.comment: Context input tokens of the run's first verified usage event; NULL without one.

columns.name: tool_calls
columns.comment: Tool call records of the run.

columns.name: failed_calls
columns.comment: Calls whose result is an error or has a non-zero exit code, counted once per call.

columns.name: edits
columns.comment: Distinct files written, edited or deleted by native edits, patches or unconditional shell commands whose call did not fail.

columns.name: failed_edits
columns.comment: Failed edit requests, excluding refusals; parser 9 or newer.

columns.name: refused_edits
columns.comment: Refused native edit requests, including user declines but excluding interruptions; parser 9 or newer.

columns.name: reads
columns.comment: Tool calls in the read group.

columns.name: searches
columns.comment: Tool calls in the search group.

columns.name: not_found
columns.comment: Read and search calls whose result records that they found nothing: Claude Code's zero-result text, zero match or file counts or returnCodeInterpretation 'No matches found', the shell's no matches found for a file pattern, a search that printed nothing (unless its command silences or redirects its output), or a failure whose text says not found, no such file, ENOENT or does not exist; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it (Claude Code before parser 6, and its subagent streams, which keep no tool result details).

columns.name: denied_calls
columns.comment: Calls whose result records a denial_kind; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: interrupted_calls
columns.comment: Calls whose result records interrupted = true; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: timed_out_calls
columns.comment: Calls whose result records timedOutAfterMs; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: approvals_by_user
columns.comment: Calls whose result records a permission decision the user accepted (Claude Code permissionDecision accept with source user_temporary, allowed once at a prompt, or user_permanent, allowed at a prompt from then on, which also marks the later calls the rule it saved allows, with reasonType rule; permission_prompts counts only the prompts). NULL when the agent records no permission decisions: Codex, Claude Code before 2.1.293, a run none of whose results records one (some subagent streams write none), and runs built before the column existed.

columns.name: approvals_by_hook
columns.comment: Calls whose result records a permission decision a hook accepted (permissionDecision accept with source hook). NULL when the agent records no permission decisions: Codex, Claude Code before 2.1.293, a run none of whose results records one (some subagent streams write none), and runs built before the column existed.

columns.name: approvals_by_config
columns.comment: Calls whose result records a permission decision configuration accepted without asking (permissionDecision accept with source config: the permission mode, reasonType mode; the auto mode classifier, classifier; an allow rule, rule). NULL when the agent records no permission decisions: Codex, Claude Code before 2.1.293, a run none of whose results records one (some subagent streams write none), and runs built before the column existed.

columns.name: permission_prompts
columns.comment: Calls a person decided at a permission prompt while the agent waited: accepted (permissionDecision source user_temporary or user_permanent without a reasonType; with reasonType rule a saved rule decided and nobody was asked) or rejected (denial_kind user-rejected). The wait is in the call's own time. NULL when the agent records no permission decisions: Codex, Claude Code before 2.1.293, a run none of whose results records one (some subagent streams write none), and runs built before the column existed.

columns.name: mcp_calls
columns.comment: Calls with a recorded MCP server; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: mcp_servers
columns.comment: MCP servers recorded on the run's calls, sorted.

columns.name: mcp_unavailable
columns.comment: MCP servers the stream's latest server-state record at or before the run's end lists as needing authentication or failed to connect (Claude Code deferred_tools_delta needsAuthMcpServers and failedMcpServers names), sorted; the stream's own records, carried from run to run until the next such record. Empty when that record lists none, or the stream recorded no server state; still connecting (pendingMcpServers) is not unavailable.

columns.name: skills
columns.comment: Skills of the run: Claude attributionSkill values and the skill input of Skill tool calls, sorted.

columns.name: slash_commands
columns.comment: Command names of the run's Claude slash-command records, without the leading slash, sorted.

columns.name: subagent_types
columns.comment: subagent_type inputs of the run's Claude Task and Agent tool calls, sorted.

columns.name: compactions
columns.comment: Compaction records of the run.

columns.name: compact_trigger
columns.comment: First Claude compactMetadata trigger of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: compact_pre_tokens
columns.comment: First Claude compactMetadata preTokens of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it or none was.

columns.name: aborted
columns.comment: true when a record of the run says aborted (Codex turn_aborted, Claude interruptedByShutdown), false when records say only false, empty when none says; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: abort_reason
columns.comment: First Codex turn_aborted reason of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: turn_error
columns.comment: First Codex task_complete error message of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: turn_error_kind
columns.comment: First Codex task_complete codex_error_info of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: interrupt_markers
columns.comment: Interrupt marker records of the run (Claude [Request interrupted by user], Codex turn_aborted wrappers).

columns.name: stop_reason
columns.comment: Last Claude assistant stop_reason recorded in the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: hook_stop_reason
columns.comment: First Claude stop hook stopReason of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: prevented_continuation
columns.comment: true when a stop hook summary of the run records preventedContinuation, false when they record only false; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: hook_count
columns.comment: Sum of the hookCount of the run's stop hook summaries; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it or none was.

columns.name: hook_errors
columns.comment: JSON array of the run's stop hook hookErrors in record order; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: hook_runs
columns.comment: JSON array of the run's stop hook hookInfos (command, durationMs) in record order; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: api_errors
columns.comment: Claude API error records of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: api_error
columns.comment: First Claude API error of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: api_error_statuses
columns.comment: Claude apiErrorStatus values of the run, sorted.

columns.name: retry_attempts
columns.comment: Claude API retry records of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: rate_limit_max_used_percent
columns.comment: The highest used_percent of a provider rate-limit window that the run's records report (Codex token_count rate_limits, primary and secondary windows). The windows are the account's (5 hours, 7 days), so other sessions' use counts too, and 100 is a full window, not a refused request (rate_limited says that). NULL when no record of the run reports one (Codex versions or plans that write none; Claude Code reports quota only with a refused request), and on runs built before the column existed.

columns.name: rate_limited
columns.comment: true when a record of the run says a request was refused for a rate or usage limit: a Claude Code API error rate_limit (HTTP 429) or quotaLimits status rejected, a Codex turn error usage_limit_exceeded; false when none says so. A limit the agent waited out without such a record is not seen. NULL when the parser version cannot record it, and on runs built before the column existed.

columns.name: refusals
columns.comment: Claude model refusal records of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: fallback_model
columns.comment: First Claude fallbackModel of the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: goal
columns.comment: Last Codex thread goal objective set in the run; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: git_operations
columns.comment: Claude gitOperation keys of the run (push, pr, branch, commit), sorted.

columns.name: pushed_branches
columns.comment: Claude gitOperation push branches of the run, sorted.

columns.name: commit_shas
columns.comment: Claude gitOperation commit SHAs of the run as recorded, sorted.

columns.name: pr_urls
columns.comment: Pull request URLs of the run from Claude gitOperation and pr-link records, sorted.

columns.name: usage_observations
columns.comment: Usage events of the session's usage extraction verified on the run's lines; on the receipt, its events assigned to no run.

columns.name: usage_unpriced
columns.comment: Of usage_observations, events without a price.

columns.name: usage_model

columns.name: cost_usd
columns.comment: Priced cost of usage_observations at pricing_version; NULL when none is priced.

columns.name: model_costs
columns.comment: Per model: priced cost (NULL when unpriced) and unpriced events, most expensive first.

columns.name: uncached_input_tokens
columns.comment: Uncached input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: cache_read_input_tokens
columns.comment: Cache read input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: cache_write_5m_input_tokens
columns.comment: Five-minute cache write input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: cache_write_1h_input_tokens
columns.comment: One-hour cache write input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: output_tokens
columns.comment: Output tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: reasoning_output_tokens
columns.comment: Reasoning output tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: pricing_version
columns.comment: Rate card version and pricing rules hash the costs were computed with.

columns.name: facts_truncated
columns.comment: Whether a record of the run dropped long fact values to the session fact budget; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: run_count
columns.comment: Receipt: runs of the generation. Its call, error, skill and model columns total or merge those of the runs.

columns.name: usage_receipt
columns.comment: Receipt: the usage extraction the costs were built from (generation:checksum, with :incomplete when it was not complete and usage is unknown); empty without usage.

columns.name: cost_state
columns.comment: Receipt: the main stream's last Claude cost-state record (cost_usd, lines, durations), keyed by fact name; empty when none.

columns.name: title
columns.comment: Receipt: last Claude ai-title of the main stream; NULL when the parser version or agent does not record it.

columns.name: repository
columns.comment: The session repository key as recorded (git remote, else package name, else project path), on every run and on the receipt; empty when none was recorded.

columns.name: cwd
columns.comment: The directory the run's shell commands ran in: per call, the literal directory its command starts by moving to (a leading cd, pushd or git -C; a leading ~ is the home directory of the recorded cwd, a relative one is joined to it), else the directory recorded for it (Claude Code record cwd, Codex CommandExecution cwd); the one most of the run's shell calls ran in, the earliest on a tie. A run without shell calls takes its first recorded cwd. NULL when none is recorded, and on runs built before the column existed.

columns.name: cwd_repository
columns.comment: The repository (host/owner/name of its git remote) the session's own records tie to cwd or the deepest directory above it, as cwd_repository_basis says; NULL when nothing ties it to one, or that directory's records name several: unknown, not the session's repository.

columns.name: cwd_repository_basis
columns.comment: What ties cwd to cwd_repository, strongest first: codex_session_meta (the git remote a Codex session_meta records for its directory), session_branch (the upload's remote, for the session's own directory, where a record shows the upload's branch), remote_output (origin URL a call there printed), transfer_remote (the remote a git push, fetch or pull there printed), gh_output (the one repository whose pull request or Actions URLs a gh pr or gh run there printed); conflicting when the records name more than one repository; empty when none.

columns.name: session_model
columns.comment: Receipt: the session model recorded at upload.

definitions.comment: L1 runs per committed transcript generation, with a receipt per session generation written last; written only by the reconciliation worker.

definitions.name: run_requests

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Session owner.

columns.name: session_id
columns.comment: Native session ID within organization and user.

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: Raw transcript revision of the run index build's generation.

columns.name: parser_version
columns.comment: Transcript records parser version of the generation.

columns.name: index_version
columns.comment: Run index rules version of the build.

columns.name: build_revision
columns.comment: Run index build that wrote the request; the session's newest run index receipt names the build readers read.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Transcript stream; empty for the main stream.

columns.name: start_record
columns.comment: Raw record index of the request's first response record (assistant text, reasoning or tool call); stable across re-uploads, like run ids.

columns.name: source
columns.comment: Transcript source: claude_code or codex.

columns.name: run_id
columns.comment: Run node id of the run the request belongs to (run_index.run_id).

columns.name: run_start_record
columns.comment: start_record of the run the request belongs to.

columns.name: turn_idx
columns.comment: Run number within the stream.

columns.name: built_at
columns.comment: UTC millisecond time the worker wrote the row.

columns.name: session_date
columns.comment: Session date of the generation.

columns.name: unrecorded_facts
columns.comment: Columns of this row whose values are unknown, not none: the usage columns when the session's usage extraction was incomplete.

columns.name: end_record
columns.comment: Start of the next request of the run, or the run's end_record: the request's lines are [start_record, end_record), and its usage is on them (the first request's from the run's start).

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: When the model was asked: the time of the run's last non-meta record before the request (the prompt or the previous request's last record).

columns.name: ended_at
columns.comment: Time of the request's last non-meta record.

columns.name: call_records
columns.comment: Raw record index of each tool call the request made, in record order.

columns.name: call_tools
columns.comment: Tool name of each call, in call_records order.

columns.name: call_groups
columns.comment: Tool group of each call (shell, edit, read, search, browser, web, mcp, subagent, other), in call_records order.

columns.name: call_classes
columns.comment: Command class the parser gave each shell call (test, build, lint, typecheck, git, migrate, install, other; empty for other tools), in call_records order.

columns.name: call_failed
columns.comment: 1 when the call's result is an error or a non-zero exit code, in call_records order.

columns.name: text_record
columns.comment: Raw record index of the request's last assistant text; NULL when the request wrote none.

columns.name: text_block
columns.comment: Block of that assistant text within its record (a line can hold reasoning, then text); NULL when the request wrote none.

columns.name: text_head
columns.comment: First 160 characters of that assistant text; NULL when the request wrote none.

columns.name: usage_observations
columns.comment: Verified usage events of the session's usage extraction on the request's lines.

columns.name: usage_unpriced
columns.comment: Of usage_observations, events without a price.

columns.name: usage_model
columns.comment: Model of the request's latest usage event; empty without usage.

columns.name: cost_usd
columns.comment: Priced cost of usage_observations at the build's pricing; NULL when none is priced or the usage is unknown.

columns.name: uncached_input_tokens
columns.comment: Uncached input tokens of the request's usage events; NULL without usage or when the session's usage is unknown.

columns.name: cache_read_input_tokens
columns.comment: Cache read input tokens of the request's usage events; NULL without usage or when the session's usage is unknown.

columns.name: cache_write_5m_input_tokens
columns.comment: Five-minute cache write input tokens of the request's usage events; NULL without usage or when the session's usage is unknown.

columns.name: cache_write_1h_input_tokens
columns.comment: One-hour cache write input tokens of the request's usage events; NULL without usage or when the session's usage is unknown.

columns.name: output_tokens
columns.comment: Output tokens of the request's usage events; NULL without usage or when the session's usage is unknown.

columns.name: reasoning_output_tokens
columns.comment: Reasoning output tokens of the request's usage events; NULL without usage or when the session's usage is unknown.

definitions.comment: L1 requests (one model response and its calls) of each run index build, committed by the build's run index receipt; written only by the reconciliation worker.

definitions.name: weekly_totals

columns.name: refreshed_at
columns.comment: UTC time the refresh that wrote the snapshot started; snapshots expire after 14 days.

columns.name: refresh_id
columns.comment: Snapshot id (replica host and refreshed_at). Each refresh appends a full snapshot, and readers read only the newest complete one.

columns.name: snapshot_rows
columns.comment: Rows of the snapshot; a snapshot with fewer rows stored is incomplete and never read.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Member: the sessions' owner.

columns.name: agent
columns.comment: Transcript source: claude_code or codex.

columns.name: week
columns.comment: Monday (UTC) of the ISO week the runs started in; the usage no run claims counts in the week of its session date.

columns.name: runs
columns.comment: Runs (one human prompt and everything until the next) that started in the week, subagent streams included.

columns.name: sessions
columns.comment: Sessions with a run that started in the week. A session that spans weeks counts in each, so it does not add up across weeks.

columns.name: sessions_started
columns.comment: Sessions whose first run started in the week; adds up across weeks.

columns.name: genuine_prompts
columns.comment: Human prompts of the runs of the row (queued prompts included, delegated tasks not).

columns.name: minutes
columns.comment: Wall-clock minutes of the runs of the row, each from its first record to its last non-meta record.

columns.name: active_minutes
columns.comment: Active minutes of the runs of the row: gaps between non-meta records, each capped at five minutes.

columns.name: tool_calls
columns.comment: Tool call records of the runs of the row.

columns.name: failed_calls
columns.comment: Calls of the runs of the row whose result is an error or has a non-zero exit code.

columns.name: edits
columns.comment: Sum of each run's distinct files written, edited or deleted by calls that did not fail.

columns.name: reads
columns.comment: Tool calls in the read group of the runs of the row.

columns.name: searches
columns.comment: Tool calls in the search group of the runs of the row.

columns.name: not_found_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record reads and searches that found nothing (run index 3 or newer; Claude Code parser 6 or newer on its main stream, Codex every parser); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: not_found
columns.comment: Read and search calls that found nothing, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: compactions
columns.comment: Compaction records of the runs of the row.

columns.name: interrupt_markers
columns.comment: Interrupt marker records of the runs of the row (Claude [Request interrupted by user], Codex turn_aborted wrappers).

columns.name: edit_outcomes_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record failed and refused edits (parser 9 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: failed_edits
columns.comment: Failed edit requests, excluding refusals, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: refused_edits
columns.comment: Refused native edit requests, including user declines but excluding interruptions, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: denied_calls_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record denials (parser 9 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: denied_calls
columns.comment: Calls whose result records a denial_kind, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: interrupted_calls_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record interrupted calls (Claude Code parser 6, Codex parser 8 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: interrupted_calls
columns.comment: Calls whose result records interrupted = true, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: timed_out_calls_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record timed-out calls (Claude Code parser 6 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: timed_out_calls
columns.comment: Calls whose result records timedOutAfterMs, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: mcp_calls_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record MCP calls (Claude Code parser 9, Codex parser 6 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: mcp_calls
columns.comment: Calls with a recorded MCP server, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: api_errors_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record API errors (Claude Code parser 7, Codex parser 9 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: api_errors
columns.comment: API error records (Claude API errors, Codex terminal provider or transport errors), summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: retry_attempts_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record API retries (Claude Code parser 7 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: retry_attempts
columns.comment: Claude API retry records, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: refusals_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record model refusals (Claude Code parser 7 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: refusals
columns.comment: Claude model refusal records, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: aborted_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record an abort (parser 7 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: aborted_runs
columns.comment: Runs a record says aborted (Codex turn_aborted, Claude interruptedByShutdown), summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: turn_error_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record a turn error (Codex parser 7 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: turn_error_runs
columns.comment: Runs whose Codex task_complete records an error, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: git_operations_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record Claude gitOperation (Claude Code parser 6 or newer; Codex git activity is in find source=git); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: push_runs
columns.comment: Runs with a Claude gitOperation push, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: commit_runs
columns.comment: Runs with a Claude gitOperation commit, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: pr_runs
columns.comment: Runs with a Claude gitOperation pr, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: commit_shas
columns.comment: Distinct Claude gitOperation commit SHAs of each run, added up, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: pr_urls_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record pull request URLs (Claude Code parser 6 or newer, every Codex parser); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: pr_urls
columns.comment: Distinct pull request URLs of each run (named, not necessarily created), added up, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: skills_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record skills (Claude Code parser 6, Codex parser 9 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: skill_runs
columns.comment: Runs that used at least one skill, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: skills
columns.comment: Distinct skills of each run, added up, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: slash_commands_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record slash commands (Claude Code); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: slash_commands
columns.comment: Distinct slash commands of each run, added up, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: subagent_types_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs of the row that can record subagent types (Claude Code, Codex parser 9 or newer); the matching sums cover only these runs.

columns.name: subagent_type_runs
columns.comment: Runs that started a subagent with a recorded type, summed over the known runs; NULL when no run of the row can record it.

columns.name: usage_known_runs
columns.comment: Runs whose session's usage extraction was complete, so their usage and cost are known; the others count no usage.

columns.name: usage_observations
columns.comment: Usage events of the runs, plus the usage no run claims, which counts in the week of its session date.

columns.name: usage_unpriced
columns.comment: Of usage_observations, events without a price.

columns.name: cost_usd
columns.comment: Priced cost in USD of usage_observations (the runs' and the usage no run claims), at the pricing of each build; NULL when nothing is priced.

columns.name: unattributed_cost_usd
columns.comment: Of cost_usd, the priced usage no run claims, counted in the week of its session date; NULL when none.

columns.name: uncached_input_tokens
columns.comment: Uncached input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: cache_read_input_tokens
columns.comment: Cache read input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: cache_write_5m_input_tokens
columns.comment: Five-minute cache write input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: cache_write_1h_input_tokens
columns.comment: One-hour cache write input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: output_tokens
columns.comment: Output tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

columns.name: reasoning_output_tokens
columns.comment: Reasoning output tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage.

definitions.comment: Nightly snapshots of the run index summed per workspace, member, agent and ISO week; appended only by weekly_totals_mv.

columns.name: analysis_id

columns.name: step_id
columns.comment: Step whose finding cites the run; one finding per step.

columns.name: finding
columns.comment: The finding as the analysis saved it.

columns.name: author_id
columns.comment: Author of the analysis; only they read its rows until it is shared.

columns.name: shared

columns.name: quoted_owners

columns.name: saved_at

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Member who owns the run's session.

columns.name: agent_id

columns.name: turn_idx

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: Timestamp of the run's first record. Copied from the run's committed run index build when the analysis was saved.

columns.name: minutes
columns.comment: Wall-clock minutes from the first record to the last non-meta record. Copied from the run's committed run index build when the analysis was saved.

columns.name: active_minutes
columns.comment: Sum of the gaps between non-meta records, each capped at five minutes. Copied from the run's committed run index build when the analysis was saved.

columns.name: cost_usd

columns.name: uncached_input_tokens
columns.comment: Uncached input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage. Copied from the run's committed run index build when the analysis was saved.

columns.name: cache_read_input_tokens
columns.comment: Cache read input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage. Copied from the run's committed run index build when the analysis was saved.

columns.name: cache_write_5m_input_tokens
columns.comment: Five-minute cache write input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage. Copied from the run's committed run index build when the analysis was saved.

columns.name: cache_write_1h_input_tokens
columns.comment: One-hour cache write input tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage. Copied from the run's committed run index build when the analysis was saved.

columns.name: output_tokens
columns.comment: Output tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage. Copied from the run's committed run index build when the analysis was saved.

columns.name: reasoning_output_tokens
columns.comment: Reasoning output tokens of usage_observations; NULL without usage. Copied from the run's committed run index build when the analysis was saved.

definitions.name: transcript_chunks

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Member whose sessions hold the chunk; chunks are stored once per member and month.

columns.name: month
columns.comment: First day (UTC) of a month the chunk appeared in; a chunk seen in several months has a row for each, with the same vector.

columns.name: chunk_hash
columns.comment: First 128 bits of the SHA-256 of the chunk text, as hex: the chunk's identity within the member's sessions.

columns.name: text
columns.comment: Chunk text after the secret filter, at most 1,200 characters, cut at a line end where possible.

columns.name: embedding
columns.comment: text-embedding-3-small vector at 512 dimensions, scaled so its largest component is ±127 (cosine does not depend on the scale); empty while not embedded.

columns.name: model
columns.comment: Model and dimensions of the vector, e.g. text-embedding-3-small@512; empty while not embedded.

columns.name: embedded_at
columns.comment: Replacing version: UTC time the vector was written, or 1970-01-01 for a chunk stored without one, so an embedded row replaces it.

definitions.comment: Distinct chunks of transcript text per member and month with their 8-bit vectors, for search by meaning and exact string.

definitions.name: transcript_chunk_hits

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Session owner.

columns.name: source
columns.comment: Transcript source: claude_code or codex.

columns.name: session_id
columns.comment: Native session ID within organization and user.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Transcript stream; empty for the main stream and the receipt.

columns.name: record_idx
columns.comment: Transcript record of the hit; 4294967295 for the session's receipt.

columns.name: block_idx
columns.comment: Content block of the record.

columns.name: chunk_idx
columns.comment: Place of the chunk in the block's text, from 0.

columns.name: turn_idx
columns.comment: Run number within the stream; zero for the receipt.

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: Record kind of the hit: user_prompt, assistant_text, reasoning, tool_call, tool_result or file_change; receipt for the receipt.

columns.name: tool_name
columns.comment: Tool of a tool call or result; empty otherwise.

columns.name: ts
columns.comment: UTC time of the record.

columns.name: chunk_hash
columns.comment: The chunk (transcript_chunks.chunk_hash of the same member); empty for the receipt.

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: Raw transcript revision of the transcript records generation the hits were cut from.

columns.name: parser_version
columns.comment: Transcript records parser version of that generation.

columns.name: pending_chunks
columns.comment: Receipt only: chunks of the generation still without a vector (over the workspace's OpenAI quota or out of time); 0 when all are embedded.

columns.name: truncated_records
columns.comment: Receipt only: records searched by their kept prefix and tail only, because transcript records did not keep their middle.

columns.name: written_at
columns.comment: Replacing version: UTC time the row was written, so a later pass over the same generation wins (its receipt counts fewer pending chunks).

definitions.comment: Where each transcript chunk appeared, by run and transcript records generation; a receipt row closes each generation.

definitions.name: setup_texts

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Member whose session received the text; each member's copy is deleted with their account.

columns.name: version
columns.comment: SHA-256 (hex) of the whole text as UTF-8: the setup file version.

columns.name: chars
columns.comment: Code points of the whole text.

columns.name: text
columns.comment: The text as the agent received it; its first 1,048,576 UTF-16 code units when longer (text_cut).

columns.name: text_cut
columns.comment: Whether text holds only the start of a longer text.

columns.name: written_at
columns.comment: UTC millisecond time the writer stored this copy.

definitions.comment: Received setup texts (instruction files, skill bodies, MCP instructions, system prompts), each distinct text once per member under its SHA-256; written by the transcript-records writer.

definitions.name: run_setup

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Session owner.

columns.name: session_id
columns.comment: Native session ID within organization and user.

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: Raw transcript revision of the run index build's generation.

columns.name: parser_version

columns.name: index_version

columns.name: build_revision

columns.name: agent_id

columns.name: run_start_record

columns.name: setup_file
columns.comment: The setup file, named by where it lives rather than by a machine path: repository:<repository>:<path>, plugin:<plugin>:<path>, member:<member>:<path>, harness:<agent>:<part> or mcp:<server>.

columns.name: version
columns.comment: SHA-256 (hex) of the text received: the setup file version; setup_texts holds the text.

columns.name: source
columns.comment: Transcript source: claude_code or codex.

columns.name: run_id
columns.comment: Run node id of the run (run_index.run_id).

columns.name: turn_idx
columns.comment: Run number within the stream.

columns.name: built_at
columns.comment: UTC millisecond time the worker wrote the row.

columns.name: session_date
columns.comment: Session date of the generation.

columns.name: run_started_at

columns.name: kind

columns.name: scope

columns.name: cwd

columns.name: chars

columns.name: version_name
columns.comment: The version as shown: its first 12 hex digits, followed by 'uncommitted by <member>' when the text was uncommitted in that member's checkout.

columns.name: uncommitted
columns.comment: For a repository file: true when the git status the session recorded at its start lists the file as changed, or the session changed the file before receiving it; false when that status was recorded whole without it; NULL when unknown (no git status recorded, a cut status, not a repository file).

columns.name: carried
columns.comment: True when the text was received before the run started (earlier in its stream) and was still the latest version of its setup file; false when received during the run.

columns.name: compacted_since
columns.comment: True when the stream recorded a compaction between receiving the text and the run's end: the text may have left the context.

columns.name: received_record
columns.comment: Raw record index of the line that carried the text.

columns.name: received_block
columns.comment: Block of that line's record.

columns.name: received_at
columns.comment: Time of the line that carried the text.

definitions.comment: Received setup of each run of a run index build: one row per run and setup file version it had, committed by the build's run index receipt; written only by the reconciliation worker.

definitions.name: session_saved_outputs

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Session owner.

columns.name: session_id
columns.comment: Native session ID within organization and user.

columns.name: session_source
columns.comment: Transcript source: claude_code or codex.

columns.name: root_id
columns.comment: Capture root of the file: claude-task-outputs (the session's tasks directory) or claude-tool-results (its tool-results directory).

columns.name: path
columns.comment: Path relative to the root: <task id>.output or rerooted/<task id>.output for a task output, the file name for a tool output.

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: task_output (a background Bash, Monitor or agent task) or tool_result (a tool output too large for the transcript).

columns.name: task_id
columns.comment: Claude Code's background task id (L1 facts['task_id']); empty for a tool output.

columns.name: tool_use_id
columns.comment: Tool call that started the task or produced the tool output, as the transcript names it; empty when unknown.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Transcript stream of the referencing record; empty for the main stream or no reference.

columns.name: record_idx
columns.comment: 1-based JSONL line of the referencing record in its stream (the starting call's result when known); 0 without a reference.

columns.name: entry_kind
columns.comment: What was on disk: file, symlink (an async agent's output, a link to its subagent transcript; never read) or empty for missing.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: captured (whole file), truncated (its tail), reused (content sent with an earlier capture, blob_capture_id), omitted (file seen, content not kept: omitted_reason), symlink, or missing (named by the transcript, not on disk at capture time).

columns.name: omitted_reason
columns.comment: Why an omitted file's content was not kept (the CLI's reason, e.g. file-content-cap, binary); empty otherwise.

columns.name: blob_object_id
columns.comment: Evidence object (sha256:<hex>) holding the secret-filtered text; empty without content.

columns.name: blob_capture_id
columns.comment: Capture whose upload carried the blob: this capture, or the earlier one of a reused blob.

columns.name: source_bytes
columns.comment: Bytes of the file that the stored text was made from.

columns.name: stored_bytes
columns.comment: Bytes of the stored, secret-filtered text.

columns.name: original_bytes
columns.comment: Size of the whole file when only its tail was kept (truncated); 0 otherwise.

columns.name: truncated
columns.comment: Whether the stored text is only the end of a longer file.

columns.name: file_modified_at
columns.comment: Modification time of the file at capture time; NULL when missing.

columns.name: capture_id
columns.comment: Evidence capture (context id) that wrote the row.

columns.name: captured_at
columns.comment: When that capture completed on the member's machine.

columns.name: capture_reason
columns.comment: Empty for a capture at the session's own time; task-output-sweep for a later one-time capture of the session's saved outputs.

columns.name: version
columns.comment: Replacing version: rank (3 with content or a symlink, 2 omitted, 1 missing) * 2^48 + captured_at in ms, so a later capture replaces an earlier one unless it knows less.

columns.name: written_at
columns.comment: UTC millisecond time the API accepted the capture and staged the row.

definitions.comment: Saved outputs of a session (background task outputs, large tool outputs) as its evidence captures uploaded them: one row per session and file, the latest capture's; the text is the evidence object blob_object_id.

definitions.name: session_images

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning workspace ID; tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Session owner.

columns.name: session_id
columns.comment: Native session ID within organization and user.

columns.name: session_source
columns.comment: Transcript source: claude_code or codex.

columns.name: sha256
columns.comment: SHA-256 (hex) of the decoded image bytes, as the transcript marker names it; the evidence object is sha256:<sha256>.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Transcript stream of the record that carries the image; empty for the main stream or no record.

columns.name: record_idx
columns.comment: 1-based JSONL line of that record in its stream; 0 for an image the capture lists without a record.

columns.name: media_type
columns.comment: Image media type (image/png, image/jpeg, ...); the uploaded object's when captured.

columns.name: bytes
columns.comment: Decoded image size in bytes; the uploaded object's when captured.

columns.name: image_source
columns.comment: inline (base64 in the transcript record) or file (an image file the record names); empty without a record.

columns.name: root_id
columns.comment: Capture root of a file image; empty otherwise.

columns.name: path
columns.comment: Path of a file image, as the CLI names it; empty otherwise.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: captured (the capture uploaded the image or found it stored), skipped (the CLI did not upload it: skipped_reason) or not_uploaded (named, not part of the capture's upload).

columns.name: skipped_reason
columns.comment: Why the CLI skipped the image (its reason, e.g. too-large, unreadable); empty otherwise.

columns.name: capture_id
columns.comment: Evidence capture (context id) that wrote the row.

columns.name: captured_at
columns.comment: When that capture completed on the member's machine.

columns.name: version
columns.comment: Replacing version: rank (3 captured, 2 skipped, 1 not_uploaded) * 2^48 + captured_at in ms, so a later capture replaces an earlier one unless it knows less.

columns.name: written_at
columns.comment: UTC millisecond time the API accepted the capture and staged the row.

definitions.comment: Images of a session (screenshots, pasted images) as its evidence captures listed them: one row per session, image and transcript record, the most knowing capture's; the bytes are the evidence object sha256:<sha256>.
